en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (rh) narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. Matil al-Daqqaq narrated to us. He said: Ya`qub b. Yazid narrated to us from al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Faddal from al-Daylami – and he is Sulayman – from `Abdullah b. Latif al-Taflisi. He said: Al-Sadiq Abu `Abdillah Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said:

When al-Husayn b. `Ali (as) was struck with the sword, and they prepared to sever his head, a caller called from the direction of the Lord of Glory from the depth of the Throne, saying: “O Nation that has become perplexed and misguided after its Prophet! Allah will not allow you to find success in Adha nor in Fitr.” He said: Then, Abu `Abdillah (as) said: By Allah, they will never find support nor success until the Revolutionary of al-Husayn (as) rises.
